And if again the answer is YES, then !!! Or simply deny for this proposal. Are we in a position to deny the proposal even if the ISTAKHARA is YES - FIRST AND SECOND TIME !!! Please advise. Khuda Hafiz. 2379 views Q. What says Uluma-e-Karam in the light of Quran-o-Sunnah: There is a practice in our area according to which Nikah is done in proper Islamic way at the time of engagement but at the time of rukhsati, again Nikah is done in the same way. Uluma doing so admit the fact that once Nikah is done at the time of engagement, it is not necessary to repeat it at the time of rukhsati however they says it is better to repeat it ( or renew it ) at the time of rukhsati. It is necessary to mention here that it is an integaral part of the marriage ceremony in our area to arrange a function of doing nikah on the evening of Shabe-uroosi in which all close relatives participate. So if this function is not done, there would be confusion in the mind of relatives. My question is: ? whether this practice of repeating nikah is according to Quran-o-Sunnah and is there any evidence available in Sunnah. ? Is there any Hadees proving that this practice is forbidden. ? Then in case there is no evidence available in Sunah regarding allowing or disallowing, whether one can be allowed to repeat nikah for the sake of making people?s mind clear. 3765 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 46172 Country: India Title: Mahr related Question: I got married in May 2005 and at that time my mahr was 75000 Indian rupees. I have not yet paid my wife any amount and now I want to give her the amount kindly let me know that how much I am suppose to pay if I pay now. It was said that its sikka raijul waqt. Answer ID: 46172 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1019/678/L=1434) You will have to pay the same amount of mahr which was fixed at that time i.e. INR 75000. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
